BillIn.title: BillIn
BillIn.description: A table's bill for this visit (`table_id`), or one takeaway order's bill (`order_id`).

ComponentsIn.title: ComponentsIn
ComponentsIn.description: The combo's dishes. Empty = an ordinary item again. At least two dishes (or one dish twice) otherwise.

DiscountIn.title: DiscountIn
DiscountIn.description: Either `percent_bp` (1000 = 10%) or `amount_minor` (paise), and why. Computed and capped on the server.

HoldIn.title: HoldIn
HoldIn.description: FREE clears a hold (the table is clean, or the reservation is off). RESERVED takes a short note.

paper_mm.title: Paper Mm
paper_mm.description: 58 or 80: also return ESC/POS bytes for a thermal printer

OrderIn.title: OrderIn
OrderIn.description: A table order (`table_id`) or a takeaway / counter order (`takeaway: true`, no table).

paper_mm.title: Paper Mm
paper_mm.description: 58 or 80 to also get ESC/POS bytes

QuoteIn.title: QuoteIn
QuoteIn.description: Item ids and quantities only. Prices are never accepted from the client (rule 4).

RuleIn.title: RuleIn
RuleIn.description:
`days`: Monday = 1, Tuesday = 2, Wednesday = 4 ... Sunday = 64 (127 = every day). Times are the hotel's local
times; an end before the start crosses midnight. `category_ids` null = the whole menu.

SplitLineIn.title: SplitLineIn
SplitLineIn.description:
One grouped line of the table: `qty` = whole units per guest (one number per guest, adding up to the line's
quantity), or `shared` = guest numbers (from 1) who share the whole line equally.

VariantsIn.title: VariantsIn
VariantsIn.description:
The item's full list of sizes, in order. Empty = no sizes (the item's own price applies). Two or more
otherwise: a single "variant" is just the price.
